newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica files prospectus, details sale.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica files prospectus, details sale.

text.p: Spanish telecommunications group Telefonica de Espana SA said on Friday it had filed its prospectus for the sale of 20.94 percent of its stock.
The offering size is 171 million shares or 18.2 percent with the rest in the green shoe and the retail fidelity bonus.

"The filing is a pre-requisite for opening the pre-registration period and for the publicity campaign for the retail tranche of the offering. This portion of the sale is directed to the general public and to Telefonica employees and retirees," Telefonica said in a brief statement detailing the offer.

The domestic tranche of the Telefonica offer represents 58 percent of the total, with the foreign tranche at 42 percent. The retail tranche of Telefonica is 50 percent of the domestic offering, but may rise to as much as 60 percent, Telefonica said.
Telefonica said it would keep 20.53 million shares for the green shoe, and 5.13 million for the retail fidelity bonus.
Telefonica said that if the share price were 3,300 pesetas a share the value of the state's holding in Telefonica would be 650 billion pesetas.
